subject: Interim settlement: seat laddering & partial-month add-on credit (Novatools)
messages:
From: Remy Duval <remy.duval@novatools.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@novatools.io
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 08:12:00 +0000
Subject: Reconcile April pro-rata & add-on charge (Novatools / NT-332)

Hi Tessa,

We pulled the April invoice and noticed two items that need reconciliation after our mid-month changes:

- On 2027-04-10 we added 12 seats to our production pool (moving from 28 -> 40 seats).
- On 2027-04-15 we enabled the "High-I/O Storage" add-on for two projects.

The invoice seems to have charged the full add-on for the month and billed only a partial seat credit that doesn't match our expected pro-rata. Can you: 1) confirm how you computed the partial-month credit for seats, and 2) share the calculation for the add-on charge?

Relevant account details: Novatools (Buyer ID NT-332), VAT FR123456789 (we are an EU entity). I've attached the PDF of the invoice we downloaded.

We'd prefer a credit on the next invoice rather than a refund. Also copy AP for the PO reconciliation.

Thanks,
Remy
Accounts & Ops
Novatools

Attachment: Invoice_2027-04-01.pdf (pdf)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Remy Duval <remy.duval@novatools.io>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 12:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Reconcile April pro-rata & add-on charge (Novatools / NT-332)

Hi Remy — thanks for the note and for attaching the invoice. Sorry for the confusion here.

Quick answers up front: we can apply a credit on your May invoice for the seat pro-rata and correct the add-on charge. Because you have an EU VAT number (FR123456789), we'll apply the reverse-charge treatment on the corrected invoice once we have a copy of the VAT cert on file.

Can you confirm two quick details so billing can finalize the numbers:
- Which of the 12 added seats were for Production vs. Sandbox (prod licenses are billed at the standard seat rate, sandbox at 40% of seat rate).
- Do you want the add-on charge adjusted to a per-project daily pro-rata, or to a single consolidated add-on credit?

Ive looped in Ben (AE) and Laura (Billing). Laura, I captured Remy's invoice — could you draft a proposed credit and indicate whether we should issue a credit memo or apply a carry-forward credit to the May invoice? Attached is a quick calculation template we use (proposed_credit_calc.xlsx).

Next steps: once you confirm seat types and VAT cert, Laura will share the calc and we'll confirm with Remy.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Remy Duval <remy.duval@novatools.io>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, accounts-payable@novatools.io
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Reconcile April pro-rata & add-on charge (Novatools / NT-332)

Hi Remy — thanks for the details. I ran a provisional calculation based on the invoice and the change dates you provided. I've attached the spreadsheet (proposed_credit_calc.xlsx) and summarize below.

Assumptions used (please confirm if any differ):
- Monthly seat rate (prod): EUR 400 / seat / month
- Monthly seat rate (sandbox): EUR 160 / seat / month (40% of prod)
- Add-on (High-I/O Storage): EUR 1,200 / project / month
- April 2027 has 30 days; seats added on 2027-04-10 -> 21 days of additional seats billed to date; add-on enabled 2027-04-15 -> 16 days billed.

Seat pro-rata correction (12 seats added on 4/10):
- If all 12 are prod: credit = 12 * EUR 400 * (10 days free / 30 days) = 12 * 400 * 0.3333 = EUR 1,600.00
- If 8 prod + 4 sandbox: credit = (8 * 400 + 4 * 160) * 0.3333 = (3200 + 640) * 0.3333 = EUR 1,280.00

Add-on correction (2 projects enabled on 4/15):
- Full-month charge was EUR 2,400 (2 * 1,200). Correct pro-rata for 16/30 days -> should be EUR 2,400 * (16/30) = EUR 1,280.00. Proposed credit = EUR 2,400 - EUR 1,280.00 = EUR 1,120.00

Provisional totals (examples):
- Scenario A (all prod): Seat credit EUR 1,600 + add-on credit EUR 1,120 = EUR 2,720.00
- Scenario B (8 prod / 4 sandbox): Seat credit EUR 1,280 + add-on credit EUR 1,120 = EUR 2,400.00

VAT / reverse-charge note: you indicated VAT FR123456789. Once we receive a VAT certificate/registration extract, the corrected invoice will carry a reverse-charge note (no VAT applied). If we don't receive documentation within 10 business days we'll leave the tax treatment as charged today and issue the credit net of VAT (if applicable).

Next steps suggested:
1) Remy to confirm seat types (prod vs sandbox).
2) Remy to attach VAT certificate (if available).
3) Redwood issues a Credit Memo for the confirmed amount and applies it as a carry-forward credit to your May invoice (unless you request a refund).

If you'd like, we can fast-track the credit memo after step 1 and then update tax handling when the VAT cert arrives.

Laura Bennett
Billing Lead — Redwood Inference
Attachment: proposed_credit_calc.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Remy Duval <remy.duval@novatools.io>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, accounts-payable@novatools.io
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 16:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Reconcile April pro-rata & add-on charge (Novatools / NT-332)

Thanks Laura — that breakdown helps a lot. Confirming:
- Seat split was 9 prod + 3 sandbox.
- VAT attachment (VAT_cert_Novatools_FR123456789.pdf) is attached here; please confirm once you have it.
- We prefer a credit memo applied to May (carry-forward).

If the provisional calculation is correct, Scenario C (9 prod / 3 sandbox) would be:
- Seat credit = (9*400 + 3*160) * (10/30) = (3600 + 480) * 0.3333 = EUR 1,360.00 (rounded)
- Add-on credit = EUR 1,120.00
- Total credit = EUR 2,480.00

Please issue a credit memo for EUR 2,480.00 and mark the corrected invoice as reverse-charge (VAT certificate attached). AP will reconcile against the May statement.

Thanks — Remy (AP)

Attachment: VAT_cert_Novatools_FR123456789.pdf (pdf)
